page.layout: One page of text, centred column; a dedicatory letter ending with place, date, signature and a catchword-like mark at lower right. Show-through from the reverse page is faint in the background and not transcribed. Below the signature line at lower right is a small printed mark "Eυφη-" (catchword-style, shown as the word beginning the next page).
page.running_head: Ornament headpiece at top centre (printer's ornament, not text)

main_text.p: que praeterea coelestis gratiae rore perfundere dignetur. Accipite ergo serena fronte hoc debitae meae observantiae testimonium & favete porro illi, qui est eritque.
main_text.head: Magnificentiae atq; Amplitudinis vestrae.
main_text.p: Scribebam Bremae, die 5. Martii A.Chr. clo loc LXXXIII. Devotus semper Cultor.
G. M. S.S. Th.D, & E. ST.P.

page.notes: The Roman numerals in the date line are printed with the reversed-C form ("clɔ loc"); transcribed as printed. The catchword "Eυφη-" is a hyphenated Greek-style word and may be read imperfectly. The date line and signature are set in mixed type; the place-and-date lines are small type at left, and the signature is in larger capitals. The second line of the closing signature is a reconstruction of printed initials and may contain errors. Background show-through from the verso is present and omitted.
